name: E2E Tester v4
description: Tests user flows end-to-end using Playwright. Starts the dev server, navigates through the application, interacts with the UI, takes screenshots, and verifies expected behavior.

inputs.description: JSON object with stack, framework, devServerCommand, port
Absolute path to the project repository
JSON array of implemented steps (to know what to test)

outputs.description: JSON object: { testsRun, passed, failed, flows, failures }
